assumptions.B2: one unrestricted constant bias on the PRESET candidate, which may be wrong; no access to true mask
assumptions.B3_full_oracle: offline ideal: knows and subtracts the complete 54-entry true injection including time-varying and other links

execution.raw_result_policy: exclusive stage files; existing failures completed; missing only resume

information.covariance: unscaled known-noise Gauss-Newton inverse only when full rank and finite; else null; no ridge

noise.sharing: same seed uses same standard-normal arrays across ALL conditions; all methods share one observation object

representative_cases.low_residual_large_error_rule: for every injection and car choose maximum (within-condition position-error percentile minus within-condition residual-RMS percentile), then position-error percentile descending then condition id and seed; rank-based description, not failure threshold
representative_cases.worst_rule: for every injection and car select largest B2 per-car RMSE across all conditions/seeds; ties condition id then seed; show all four methods on same input

statistics.aggregate: per condition and method; do not pool conditions or cars as independent seeds
statistics.bias_policy: No unique true constant b for step/ramp/wrong_link/multi_link. Report estimated b, candidate injection mean as descriptive reference, and full injected-vector minus b*candidate mask RMS. b error threshold only zero/constant, where the model is correctly specified.
statistics.interval: pointwise percentile of paired seed means, valid subset explicitly conditional; no multiplicity guarantee
statistics.missing_policy: null, never zero; retain all planned denominators; no superiority claim from success subset
statistics.position_metric: per-car mean squared 2D error over six epochs; per-seed RMSE=sqrt(MSE)
statistics.residual_joint_distribution: all finite final states: total whitened residual RMS, range residual RMS in metres, per-car RMSE; per-condition Spearman; deterministic scatter, no favorable binary cutoff

config.study: new model-mismatch stress test designed after reading prior results
